name: White noise machine

lead: A white noise machine plays steady broadband sound, such as white, pink or brown noise, fan sounds or nature loops, to mask sudden noises. It is used in noisy bedrooms and for infants.

For looksmaxxing it serves sleep quality. The evidence is mixed: a 2021 systematic review rated the quality of evidence for continuous noise as very low, with later reviews more favourable in hospital settings.

paras: Continuous sound reduces the contrast between background and sudden noises, so there are fewer arousals triggered by the environment. Pink noise has also been studied for effects on slow-wave sleep.

Playing noise too loudly may harm hearing, and guidance on infants stresses keeping volume and distance low. Some people find the sound disruptive. Reviews report heterogeneous studies and variable results, so the effect is best seen as helpful for some noisy-environment sleepers rather than universal.
